result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the primary “Popular right now” restaurant card has a broken/missing image, which is the most visible defect. A horizontal carousel item is also clipped at the right edge, likely intentional peek behavior but worth checking.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card under “Popular right now” shows a gray placeholder with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/asset loading, add a retry/fallback image, and ensure the card hides or replaces failed media gracefully.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” horizontal cards are cut off on the right edge, with the third restaurant name truncated (“Trattoria Piccol…”).
issues.suggestion: Confirm this is intentional carousel peeking; if not, adjust card width/margins or add clearer scrolling affordance.
